paper_title: Interstitial lung disease diagnosis and prognosis using an AI system integrating longitudinal data

concerns_full.concern_text: ILD classified by radiological pattern (UIP, NSIP) not disease (IPF, CTD-ILD). In practice, patients classified by disease. Do authors consider UIP synonymous with IPF? This limits clinical applicability.

Prognosis assessed as 3-year survival but also mentions treatment response evaluation — unclear if FVC decline in antifibrotic treatment was assessed. Which clinical features had highest prognostic value?
Discussion mentions quantitative CT information but no mention of quantitative CT analysis in the paper.

paper_title: External validation of artificial intelligence for detection of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction

concerns_full.concern_text: Unexpected non-monotonic behavior: quartile 3 of AI HFpEF shows lower observed risk than quartile 2, indicating miscalibration and potential model behavior issue requiring explanation.

paper_title: Fragmentomic liquid biopsy enables early breast cancer detection, molecular subtyping and lymph node assessment

concerns_full.concern_text: Present sensitivity/specificity pairs at multiple thresholds. Discuss which metric is more critical for breast cancer detection clinical decisions.
Comparisons with existing competitive methods (e.g., Galleri, CancerSEEK) not adequately addressed.

paper_title: A noninvasive machine learning model using a complete blood count for screening of primary vitreoretinal lymphoma

concerns_full.concern_text: Gold standard diagnostic protocol (2016 WHO classification biopsy) choice should be clarified. How were healthy controls matched to cases?
Very rare disease — PPV will be extremely low in community screening even with high AUC. Clinical utility of screening unclear.
